mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_events ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, thread_uuid, thread_external_id, event_type, payload, processed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{row.UUID}, #{row.ExternalID}, #{row.OrganizationUUID}, #{row.WorkspaceUUID}, #{row.SessionUUID}, #{row.SessionExternalID}, #{row.ThreadUUID}, #{row.ThreadExternalID}, #{row.EventType}, CAST(#{row.Payload} AS jsonb), #{row.ProcessedAt}, #{row.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
